intent: static pass/fail/warn status mark — a lifecycle state rendered inert
useWhen: showing status where the animated lifecycle states cannot be mounted
avoid: green check marks and checkbox glyphs
reducedMotion: already at rest — the mark IS the reduced-motion rest frame of a lifecycle state (pass = ripe-at-rest, warn = quiet, fail = the destructive pigment confined to a rule), so no animation exists to suppress and no separate rest pose is needed
notes: the compliant static fallback when the animated states cannot be mounted: a status mark is the inert rest frame of a lifecycle state, not a second status idiom — pass is ripe at its resting pose (accent), warn stays quiet (text-quiet), fail keeps the destructive role confined to a thin rule and never borrows the accent; dots and rules only, never a green tick or checkbox glyph
